name: ChatEntry files mode
description:
1. The user asked to redesign the **Files mode** in `ChatEntry` so new files render their full content and existing files render a diff.
2. Scope was kept to `src/components/chat/MessageFileView.vue`; `ChatEntry.vue` needed no wiring change since its props/events contract stayed identical.
3. Status is resolved per code block — authoritative `change_type` from the `<file_change>` envelope, else `files.read()` (missing/empty ⇒ new), else `files.diff()` for stats.
4. Each block renders as a DaisyUI card with status badge (`New`/`Changed`/`Deleted`), `+/-` stats, expand/collapse, content⇄diff toggle, copy, add-to-chat, sub-task and save — with a lazy-loaded `DiffViewer` and a streaming guard.
5. Accessibility and review-density were preserved: `aria-label`s everywhere, non-colour-only status, `max-h-[480px]` scroll areas, and bulk-selection keys unchanged.
